🚨 PUBLIC NOTICE – HOLI FESTIVAL 2026 | TRAFFIC ADVISORY 🚨
As per orders issued by the Cyberabad Police Commissionerate:

🔹 Wine/Toddy Shops and Bars (except Star Hotels & Registered Clubs) will remain closed from 06:00 AM to 06:00 PM on 03-03-2026.

🔹 The following are prohibited from 1800 hrs on 02-03-2026 to 0600 hrs on 04-03-2026:
• Throwing colours/coloured water on unwilling persons, vehicles, or in public places.
• Movement of two-wheelers and other vehicles in groups causing disturbance, inconvenience, or danger to the public.

🚦 Traffic Advisory:
• Do not ride in groups or perform stunts on public roads.
• Avoid rash driving, overspeeding, and triple riding.
• Strict action against Drunk & Drive violations.
• Follow helmet and seatbelt rules without exception.
• Cooperate with traffic personnel and follow diversions, if any.

⚠️ Violators will face strict legal action as per law.
Let’s celebrate Holi with joy, safety, and responsibility.

#CyberabadPolice #CyberabadTrafficPolice #Holi2026 #TrafficAdvisory #RoadSafety #NoDrunkDriving #CelebrateResponsibly #SafeHoli
